Container.Name: ZeroLeakage-Server
Container.Overview:
ZeroLeakage Server: network-wide DNS filtering (AdGuard Home / Pi-hole style) for every device on your LAN, plus encrypted DoH / DoT so your phones and laptops stay protected on mobile data. AdGuard-style lists (OISD, HaGeZi, StevenBlack...), per-device rules, CNAME-cloaking protection, query log and an optional sign-in that syncs rules with the ZeroLeakage Windows and Android apps.
Give it its own IP (br0) so it can use port 53, then set your router's DNS server to that IP. Open the WebUI to create the admin account.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, downloaded lists and optional tls.crt / tls.key

Config.Name: Dashboard / API / DoH
Config.Description: Web dashboard, REST API and DoH over HTTP (use a TLS reverse proxy for remote access)

Config.Name: DNS-over-TLS
Config.Description: Android Private DNS / DoT (needs tls.crt + tls.key in /data)

Config.Name: HTTPS
Config.Description: DoH + dashboard over HTTPS (needs tls.crt + tls.key in /data)

Config.Name: Trust reverse proxy
Config.Description: true only if your own reverse proxy sets X-Forwarded-For

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone for the query log
